diesel-fuel-pump-repair-bintulu.title: Diesel Fuel Pump Repair Bintulu | Test Bench at Batu 10
diesel-fuel-pump-repair-bintulu.desc: Diesel fuel pump repair in Bintulu: inline and rotary pumps tested and calibrated on the bench at KH Diesel, Batu 10. WhatsApp a photo for a quote.
diesel-fuel-pump-repair-bintulu.h1: Diesel Fuel Pump Repair in Bintulu
diesel-fuel-pump-repair-bintulu.intro: KH Diesel Fuel Pump repairs and calibrates diesel fuel pumps on a test bench in a clean room. The workshop is at Batu 10 on Jalan Bintulu–Miri, Bintulu.
s1_list: The engine is hard to start or cranks for a long time
Black smoke under load or a loss of power on hills
The engine hunts, surges or idles unevenly
Diesel leaking around the pump body or lines
Higher fuel use than usual for the same work
diesel-fuel-pump-repair-bintulu.s1_note: These signs can also come from injectors, filters or the turbo, which is why the pump is tested before anything is replaced.
diesel-fuel-pump-repair-bintulu.s2_h: Tested on the bench, not guessed
diesel-fuel-pump-repair-bintulu.s2_p: The pump comes off the engine and goes onto a test bench in the clean room. The green-floor room with strip curtains keeps dust away from the pump while it is open. The bench lets the pump run outside the engine, so delivery and timing can be checked and set before it goes back on.
diesel-fuel-pump-repair-bintulu.s3_p: Older lorries, pickups and machines often use inline or rotary (distributor) pumps. Tell us the vehicle or machine and the engine on WhatsApp, and send a photo of the pump label if it has one, so we can tell you what the job involves.
send_list: A clear photo of the pump and any label on it
The vehicle or machine, model and engine
What the engine is doing (smoke, power, starting)
faqs: Where do I bring the pump or vehicle?
To the KH Diesel Fuel Pump workshop at Batu 10, Jalan Bintulu–Miri, Bintulu: Sublot 14 of Parent Lot 1337 & Lot 341, Block 33, Kemena Land District, 97000 Bintulu, Sarawak.

Do you show prices on the website?
No. Every pump is different, so ask on WhatsApp and the quote comes after testing.

common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu.title: Common Rail Pump Repair Bintulu, Sarawak | KH Diesel
common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu.desc: Common rail high-pressure pump repair in Bintulu, Sarawak, at KH Diesel Fuel Pump, Batu 10, with a separate common-rail test room. WhatsApp 019-854 5433.
common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu.h1: Common Rail Pump Repair in Bintulu, Sarawak
common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu.intro: KH Diesel Fuel Pump repairs common-rail high-pressure pumps for modern diesel pickups, lorries and machines. The workshop is at Batu 10 on Jalan Bintulu–Miri, Bintulu, with a separate common-rail test room.
common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu.s1_h: When a common rail pump is the suspect
s1_list: The engine cranks but will not start, or starts and dies
Loss of power or the engine drops into limp mode
Rail pressure warnings or fault codes
Metal particles or dirty fuel found in the filter
Noise from the pump area
common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu.s1_note: Low rail pressure can also come from injectors leaking back, a blocked filter or air in the lines, so the whole system is checked before the pump is blamed.
common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu.s2_h: Why clean work matters on common rail
common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu.s2_p: Common-rail systems run at very high pressure with fine clearances, so a little dirt can do damage. The pump is opened in the clean room and checked in the common-rail test room, away from the dust of the main workshop floor.
common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu.s3_p: If the fuel was contaminated, the injectors often need testing too. We can test the injectors in the same visit; see injector repair for what that involves.
send_list: A photo of the pump and its label
The vehicle or machine and engine
Any fault codes or warning lights you have seen
faqs: Where is the workshop?
At Batu 10, Jalan Bintulu–Miri, Bintulu, near Kampung Penan Muslim Batu 10 and Jalan Nyabau.

Yes. The workshop has a separate common-rail test room as well as the clean room for pump work.

Can I also call?
Yes, call 019-854 5433, or the landline 086-340356 during opening hours (Monday to Saturday, 8:00am to 5:30pm).

injector-repair-bintulu.title: Injector Repair Bintulu: Common Rail Injector Test | KH
injector-repair-bintulu.desc: Injector repair in Bintulu: common rail and diesel injectors tested, cleaned and calibrated in the test room at KH Diesel, Batu 10. WhatsApp 019-854 5433.
injector-repair-bintulu.h1: Injector Repair and Diesel Injector Testing in Bintulu
injector-repair-bintulu.intro: KH Diesel Fuel Pump tests, cleans and calibrates common-rail injectors and older diesel injectors. The workshop is at Batu 10 on Jalan Bintulu–Miri, Bintulu, with a common-rail test room for injector work.
injector-repair-bintulu.s1_h: Signs an injector needs a test
s1_list: A knocking or rattling sound that was not there before
White or black smoke, especially at start-up
Rough idle or one cylinder misfiring
Higher fuel use
Fuel smell or diesel in the engine oil
injector-repair-bintulu.s1_note: A diesel injector test shows how each injector sprays and how much fuel it returns, so you know which ones need work instead of replacing a full set by guesswork.
injector-repair-bintulu.s2_p: Common-rail injectors on modern pickups and lorries are tested in the separate common-rail test room. Each injector is checked on its own, then cleaned and set where it can be repaired.
injector-repair-bintulu.s3_p: Mechanical diesel injectors on older lorries and machines are checked for spray pattern and opening pressure. Tell us the engine on WhatsApp so we know what you have.
send_list: How many injectors and from which engine
A photo of an injector and its part number if you can see it
faqs: Where do I bring the injectors?

How do I ask about my injectors?
WhatsApp 019-854 5433 with the engine, the number of injectors and a photo.

turbo-repair-bintulu.title: Turbo Repair Bintulu: Turbocharger Rebuild at Batu 10
turbo-repair-bintulu.desc: Turbo repair in Bintulu: turbochargers stripped, rebuilt and checked at KH Diesel Fuel Pump, Batu 10, Jalan Bintulu–Miri. WhatsApp a photo of the turbo.
turbo-repair-bintulu.h1: Turbo Repair and Turbocharger Rebuild in Bintulu
turbo-repair-bintulu.intro: KH Diesel Fuel Pump repairs and rebuilds turbochargers for diesel pickups, lorries, coaches and machines. The workshop is at Batu 10 on Jalan Bintulu–Miri, Bintulu, with turbo and parts racks on site.
s1_list: Blue or grey smoke from the exhaust
A whistle or siren noise that gets louder with revs
Loss of power when the turbo should be boosting
Oil inside the intake pipes or intercooler
Shaft play you can feel by hand with the intake off
turbo-repair-bintulu.s1_note: Smoke and power loss can also be fuel-side problems. If you are not sure, start with a fuel system diagnosis.
turbo-repair-bintulu.s2_p: The turbo is taken apart on the bench, the parts are cleaned and inspected, worn parts are replaced and it is put back together and checked before it goes back on the engine.
turbo-repair-bintulu.s3_p: Many turbo failures start with oil supply, dirty oil or something entering the intake. Fixing the cause with the turbo is what keeps the next one alive, so we will tell you what we find.

The engine runs but uses more fuel than before
